title: Randomness for Divination
content_html:
Randomness for Divination

Embodied → Electronic → Quantum

Embodied media emphasise ritual, touch, lineage
electronic media emphasise procedure and interface
quantum media emphasise physical indeterminacy.

All three can be framed as synchronistic consultations.

  • I Ching via QRNG: sample 0–63 → hexagram; sample 6 Bernoulli trials (p=1/2) or extra bits to model changing lines (1/8 each for “old” lines in coin method).
  • mo via QRNG: sample two independent integers 1–6 to preserve the natural 2–12 distribution.
  • Hybrid ritual: keep invocation/journaling even when using digital randomness to preserve embodied meaning-making.
